name: humid_air_1691_economizer_running_phase_change_kept
description: An economizer that started on dry air keeps its running fan when it moves from cool-down to maintain after the air turns humid (start-only: the guard refuses starts, it never strands or stops a running fan)
notes: 08:00 dew points: indoor 74F at 53.4% = 55.99F; outdoor 71F at 87.2% = 67.0F (at or above the 65F ceiling). Before 07:59 no humidity is known.

Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: a guard applied to the cool-down -> maintain transition (not only to a start) makes 08:00 read an inactive economizer while its fan keeps running. (b) docs-production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Humid-air guard (Issue #1691)' states this rule and production applies it through humidity_facts.humid_air_verdict. (c) occupant: a fan left running with no economizer session to stop it; or, the other way, a fan the occupant sees stop and start on a phase change.

verdict.summary: Running economizer keeps its fan across a phase change on humid air

events.note: No humidity known: cool-down engages, the fan starts.
The outdoor air turns humid while the economizer runs.
Indoor reached comfort: cool-down -> maintain (no new fan start).

assertions.reason: The running economizer moves to maintain; humidity does not stop or strand it.
The economizer's fan is still running and still owned by an economizer session (not stranded).
